$comment: Single source of truth for every agent. Edit here, not in agent files.

audience.who: HR Heads, CHROs and HR Managers at Indian enterprises

a2.description: fires when topics are approved at gate 1

optionA.note: First live batch: 3 of 3 usable. Clean, literal, well lit, reads at feed size.

optionB.note: First live batch: 0 of 3 usable - every output came back near-black and/or too abstract to read at feed size. Keep the second model for genuine variety, but the lighting directive below is now mandatory, and re-assess after the next batch. If it stays at 0, switch option B to recraft_v4_1 with model_type "utility" for a different look from the same reliable model.

images.negativePrompt: text, letters, words, typography, watermark, signature, logo, brand mark, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, handshake cliche, jigsaw puzzle, lightbulb, ladder, job fair, students, stock photo
images.lightingDirective: bright even lighting, high key, clearly legible as a thumbnail, mid-tone background, no near-black frames
images.$lightingNote: Appended to every prompt. LinkedIn renders posts on a light feed, and a dark image reads as an empty rectangle at thumbnail size.

linkedin.$modeOptions: api = publish via Community Management API; assisted = prepare and notify the owner to publish manually
linkedin.$browserAutomationNote: Never enable. Scripted browsing of linkedin.com violates their user agreement and risks the company page and the owner's personal account.
